d:
妙不可言，气息危险，
是轻如毫羽的她。
从最原始的欲望深处，
到最狂野的澎湃爱意，
每次触动都只为你。
彼之良·风铃【源始之舞/仿生2.2U系列/98cm】

Wonderful, with dangerous whisper,
that is she who is light as a feather.
From the depths of primal desire,
to the wildest surges of love,
every touch is just because of you.
Bezlya Campanula PrimordialDance, Bionic 2.2U series 98cm
